figures.finding: The Finnish Film Foundation's production support is at most €1,200,000 a film and up to 90% of approved costs; in 2025 it funded 55 of 261 production applications (€11.1 million granted of €62.4 million sought).
figures.applies: Finland, film production companies registered in Finland (not broadcasters or streamers), 2025-2026.

sources.said: The maximum amount of production support is €1,200,000. Support can cover up to 90% of the costs approved by the Finnish Film Foundation.

figures.finding: The Foundation accepts at most 5% of actual production costs as the company's fixed overheads (administrative costs).
figures.applies: Finland, films with Finnish Film Foundation production support.

sources.said: Administrative costs 5% of the actualised production costs may be fixed overheads and considered as administrative costs.

figures.finding: Business Finland's audiovisual production incentive is a cash rebate of up to 25% of production costs in Finland, for feature films, documentaries, serial fiction and animation; eligible Finnish costs may be at most 80% of the budget, public funding of the Finnish costs at most 50%, at least 25% of financing must come from abroad, and the 2026 budget is €10 million.

value.base: eligible production costs incurred in Finland
value.decree: Government Decree on the payment of compensation for audiovisual productions 2024-2026

figures.applies: Finland, international and Finnish productions with foreign financing, 2026 call.

sources.said: The production incentive in Finland is a maximum of 25% cash rebate for production costs. … The budget for the audiovisual production incentive for 2026 is 10 million euros. … Eligible costs incurred in Finland can be a maximum of 80% of the total production budget … productions in which the share of public funding in costs generated in Finland exceeds 50 percent. … At least 25 % of funding for the overall production budget must come from outside Finland

figures.finding: Finland had 44 domestic first releases among 216 in cinemas in 2025; domestic films drew 2.0 million of 6.3 million admissions (32%), and of 19 supported feature fiction films premiering, 13 cost €1-2 million, 1 under €1 million, 1 €2-3 million and 4 over €3 million.
figures.applies: Finland, cinemas, calendar 2025 (Finnish Film Foundation official statistics).
